Falcons vs Packers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, September 24 · NFL Week 3 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 23, 1:48 PM ET

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Thursday Night Football's Falcons at Packers DraftKings Showdown slate: 20.0 DraftKings points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, or 30.0 at captain for $17,700. Bijan Robinson holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 79% across 10,000 simulations, and Bijan Robinson holds the largest captain share at 30.9%.

Behind Robinson, the next four projections are Jordan Love (16.9, $10,000), Cooper Rush (13.2, $8,000), Drake London (12.9, $8,800) and MarShawn Lloyd (12.7, $7,400). Green Bay is a 6.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 25.5 for the Packers and 19 for the Falcons.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 23, 1:48 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 30.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 20.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 15.5 carries and 5.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 20.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.7 and a ceiling of 38.8. He holds 79% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 30.9% as the captain and 47.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jordan Love, GB QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jordan Love holds 16.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Love averaged 16.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 30.7. He holds 75% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.4% as the captain and 58.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Drake London, ATL WR ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Drake London holds 11.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 12.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 19.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 26.3 routes. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 12.8 points with a simulated floor of 4.2 and a ceiling of 27.3. He holds 49% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.2% as the captain and 37.9% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Falcons vs Packers

Cooper Rush, ATL QB ($8,000 FLEX / $12,000 CPT)

Cooper Rush carries the 3rd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.2 DraftKings points for an $8,000 FLEX salary ($12,000 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Rush averaged 13.2 points with a simulated floor of 4.8 and a ceiling of 24.1. He holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.0% as the captain and 0.0% in a FLEX spot.

MarShawn Lloyd, GB RB ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

MarShawn Lloyd carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.7 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 12.8 carries and 1.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Lloyd averaged 12.6 points with a simulated floor of 4.7 and a ceiling of 24.5. He holds 49% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.3% as the captain and 44.0% in a FLEX spot.

Christian Watson, GB WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Christian Watson carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.6 DraftKings points for a $9,800 FLEX salary ($14,700 at captain). The model gives him 6.7 targets on 26.3 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Watson averaged 12.5 points with a simulated floor of 4.1 and a ceiling of 26.6. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.5% as the captain and 38.8% in a FLEX spot.

Trey Smack, GB K ($5,200 FLEX / $7,800 CPT)

Trey Smack carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.9 DraftKings points for a $5,200 FLEX salary ($7,800 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Smack averaged 10.1 points with a simulated floor of 3.4 and a ceiling of 19.5. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.6% as the captain and 40.1% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Olamide Zaccheaus, ATL WR ($2,000 FLEX / $3,000 CPT)

Olamide Zaccheaus projects for 4.3 DraftKings points at a $2,000 FLEX salary, 2.17 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.8 targets on 13.6 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Zaccheaus averaged 4.3 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.3. He holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.5% as the captain and 12.3% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Nick Folk, ATL K ($4,800 FLEX / $7,200 CPT)

Nick Folk projects for 7.9 DraftKings points at a $4,800 FLEX salary, 1.65 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Folk averaged 7.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.0 and a ceiling of 16.0. He holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.2% as the captain and 27.3% in a FLEX spot.
